grammar_title: 省略(Ellipsis):状语从句中的省略 / 并列与比较结构中的省略 / 不定式与对话中的省略
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 6 Using language:Ellipsis。句子地道、灾难/救援/希望主题,答案唯一(干扰项还原成错词或错形式)。

points.point: 状语从句中省略「主语+be」(when/while/if/though/once/unless + 分词或形容词)
points.overview: 当状语从句的主语与主句主语一致时,可省去从句的「主语+be」,只留下 -ing(主动)/ -ed(被动)/ 形容词。判断:从句动作是主语主动发出用 -ing,被动承受用 -ed。

points.point: 并列与比较结构中省略重复动词(留下助动词/操作词)
points.overview: 并列句和 so/neither/nor/than/as/but 后,常省去与前面重复的动词(短语),只保留一个助动词或情态动词来代替;这个助动词要与原动词的时态、人称一致。

points.point: 不定式省略(只留 to)与对话中的省略
points.overview: 在 love/like/want/have/hope/try/able 等之后,可省去重复的动词原形,只保留不定式符号 to;在口语应答中也常省去重复的动词短语,只留一个助动词/情态动词。

questions.stem: "When ____ about the coming typhoon, the villagers quickly moved to higher ground."
questions.explanation: 从句主语 = villagers,他们是「被警告」,省略 they were 后留下被动的 -ed 形式 warned。

questions.stem: "While ____ for the rescue boat, we shared the little water we had."
questions.explanation: 从句主语 = we,主动「等待」,省略 we were 后留下 -ing 形式 waiting。

questions.stem: "Though ____ of the danger, the firefighters still rushed into the building."
questions.explanation: though they were aware 省略「主语+be」后留下形容词 aware。

questions.stem: "If ____ in time, a warning can save thousands of lives."
questions.explanation: warning 是「被送出」,省略 it is 后留下被动 -ed 形式 sent。

questions.stem: "Once ____, the wildfire spread across the dry hills within hours."
questions.explanation: wildfire 是「被点燃/被引发」,省略 it was 后留下被动 -ed 形式 started。

questions.stem: "When ____ how to stay safe, children usually listen very carefully."
questions.explanation: children 是「被告知」,省略 they are 后留下被动 -ed 形式 told。

questions.stem: "While ____ through the ruined town, the reporter could not hold back her tears."
questions.explanation: reporter 主动「行走」,省略 she was 后留下 -ing 形式 walking。

questions.stem: "Unless ____ at once, the injured man might not survive the night."
questions.explanation: man 是「被救治」,省略 he is 后留下被动 -ed 形式 treated。

questions.stem: "Though ____ from the long search, the rescuers refused to rest."
questions.explanation: rescuers「感到精疲力竭」,省略 they were 后留下形容词化的 -ed 形式 exhausted。

questions.stem: "When ____ by helicopter, the survivors finally felt safe."
questions.explanation: survivors 是「被营救」,省略 they were 后留下被动 -ed 形式 rescued。

questions.stem: "If ____ correctly, the warning system can give people enough time to leave."
questions.explanation: system 是「被使用」,省略 it is 后留下被动 -ed 形式 used。

questions.stem: "While ____ to the forecast on the radio, we packed our emergency bags."
questions.explanation: we 主动「收听」,省略 we were 后留下 -ing 形式 listening。

questions.stem: "Once ____, the announcement was repeated on every radio station in the area."
questions.explanation: announcement 是「被发布」,省略 it was 后留下被动 -ed 形式 made。

questions.stem: "Though ____ for many hours, the rescue dogs did not give up."
questions.explanation: dogs 主动「工作」,省略 they had been 后留下 -ing 形式 working。

questions.stem: "When ____ with a serious crisis, a calm leader is very important."
questions.explanation: be faced with 「面临」,人是被动一方,省略后留下 -ed 形式 faced。

questions.stem: "If ____ early enough, a small fire can be put out quite easily."
questions.explanation: fire 是「被发现」,省略 it is 后留下被动 -ed 形式 noticed。

questions.stem: "While ____ in the shelter, the children drew pictures to stay calm."
questions.explanation: children 主动「待在」,省略 they were 后留下 -ing 形式 staying。

questions.stem: "Though ____ by the disaster, the town slowly came back to life."
questions.explanation: town 是「被震撼/被冲击」,省略 it was 后留下被动 -ed 形式 shaken。

questions.stem: "Unless ____ carefully, the old houses may collapse in the next quake."
questions.explanation: houses 是「被修理」,省略 they are 后留下被动 -ed 形式 repaired。

questions.stem: "When ____ for advice, the experts always mention having an escape plan."
questions.explanation: experts 是「被询问」,省略 they are 后留下被动 -ed 形式 asked。

questions.stem: "The earthquake destroyed the school, and so ____ the old library."
questions.explanation: 前句动词 destroyed 是一般过去时,so 后省略重复动词、用过去时助动词 did 代替。

questions.stem: "My parents did not panic during the storm, and neither ____ I."
questions.explanation: 前句一般过去时,neither 后倒装并省略动词,用 did 代替。

questions.stem: "She has already packed enough food, but her brother ____ not."
questions.explanation: 前句现在完成时 has packed,省略重复动词后保留与之一致的 has。

questions.stem: "The rescue team worked far harder than anyone ____ imagined."
questions.explanation: than 后接的是先于过去发生的「想象」,与过去时主句相比用过去完成助动词 had imagined。

questions.stem: "He reacted to the warning much faster than his sister ____."
questions.explanation: 比较从句省略重复的 reacted,用过去时助动词 did 代替。

questions.stem: "I can't reach the shelter on foot, and my grandmother ____, either."
questions.explanation: 前句用情态动词 can't,省略重复动词后保留 can't。

questions.stem: "They lost their home in the flood, and so ____ we."
questions.explanation: 前句一般过去时 lost,so 后省略动词、用 did 代替。

questions.stem: "This forecast is far more reliable than the last one ____."
questions.explanation: 比较的是过去那次预报「(可靠)是」,系动词省略后保留过去时 was。

questions.stem: "Helen survived the avalanche, and so ____ her dog."
questions.explanation: 前句一般过去时 survived,so 后用 did 代替重复动词。

questions.stem: "We had not heard the announcement, and neither ____ our neighbours."
questions.explanation: 前句过去完成时 had not heard,neither 后保留 had。

questions.stem: "She will help rebuild the homes, and so ____ her classmates."
questions.explanation: 前句一般将来时 will help,so 后省略动词、保留 will。

questions.stem: "The storm caused much more damage this year than it ____ last year."
questions.explanation: 比较从句省略重复的 caused,用过去时助动词 did 代替。

questions.stem: "I am not afraid of typhoons now, but my little sister still ____."
questions.explanation: 前句用系动词 am(afraid),省略 afraid 后保留与之一致的 is。

questions.stem: "They prepared for the flood far more carefully than we ____."
questions.explanation: 比较从句省略重复的 prepared,用过去时助动词 did 代替。

questions.stem: "He has rebuilt his house already, and his neighbours ____ too."
questions.explanation: 前句现在完成时,主语 neighbours 为复数,省略动词后保留 have。

questions.stem: "We didn't get any warning, and the next village ____, either."
questions.explanation: 前句一般过去时否定 didn't get,省略动词后保留 didn't。

questions.stem: "The flood rose much faster than the rescuers ____ expected."
questions.explanation: than 后是先于过去的「预料」,用过去完成助动词 had expected。

questions.stem: "She can swim to safety, but the old man next door ____."
questions.explanation: 前句用 can,转折后表示「不能」,省略动词后保留 can't。

questions.stem: "Our town received emergency aid, and so ____ the nearby county."
questions.explanation: 前句一般过去时 received,so 后用 did 代替重复动词。

questions.stem: "I have never seen such a terrible storm, and neither ____ my grandfather."
questions.explanation: 前句现在完成时 have never seen,主语 grandfather 为第三人称单数,neither 后保留 has。

questions.stem: A: "Would you like to join the rescue team?"  B: "Yes, I'd love ____."
questions.explanation: 为避免重复 join the rescue team,只保留不定式符号 to,即 I'd love to。

questions.stem: "I didn't want to leave my home, but in the end I had ____."
questions.explanation: have to 后省略重复的 leave my home,只留 to。

questions.stem: "You don't need to stay outside in the storm if you don't want ____."
questions.explanation: want 后省略 stay outside,只保留不定式符号 to。

questions.stem: "She hoped to find her lost cat, and in the end she was lucky enough ____."
questions.explanation: enough 后省略 find her cat,只留 to。

questions.stem: "He never expected to survive the flood, but somehow he managed ____."
questions.explanation: manage 后省略 survive the flood,只保留不定式符号 to。

questions.stem: "We can rebuild the school together if we really want ____."
questions.explanation: want 后省略 rebuild the school,只留 to。

questions.stem: "I'd help carry the water bottles, but I'm just not strong enough ____."
questions.explanation: enough 后省略 carry the bottles,只保留 to。

questions.stem: "They asked us to donate some clothes, and we were very glad ____."
questions.explanation: glad 后省略 donate some clothes,只留不定式符号 to。

questions.stem: "I tried to call for help during the storm, but I just wasn't able ____."
questions.explanation: be able 后省略 call for help,只保留 to。

questions.stem: "Nobody forced him to volunteer; he chose ____ all by himself."
questions.explanation: choose 后省略 volunteer,只留不定式符号 to。

questions.stem: A: "Will the new satellites help us forecast the typhoon?"  B: "Yes, they ____."
questions.explanation: 应答省略 help us forecast the typhoon,保留与问句一致的助动词 will。

questions.stem: A: "Have the rescue teams reached the village yet?"  B: "No, they ____ yet."
questions.explanation: 问句用现在完成时 have reached,应答省略动词后保留 haven't。

questions.stem: A: "Did many families lose their homes?"  B: "Yes, thousands of them ____."
questions.explanation: 问句一般过去时 did lose,应答省略动词后保留 did。

questions.stem: A: "Could you hear the emergency announcement?"  B: "No, I ____."
questions.explanation: 问句用情态动词 could,应答省略 hear the announcement 后保留 couldn't。

questions.stem: A: "Should we leave before the storm arrives?"  B: "Yes, we ____."
questions.explanation: 问句用情态动词 should,应答省略 leave 后保留 should。

questions.stem: A: "Are the roads still flooded?"  B: "Some ____, some aren't."
questions.explanation: 问句用 are flooded,应答省略 flooded 后保留 are。

questions.stem: A: "Do you think the old bridge will hold?"  B: "I'm afraid it ____."
questions.explanation: 谈论将来 will hold,表否定时省略 hold 后保留 won't。

questions.stem: A: "Were you frightened during the earthquake?"  B: "Yes, I ____."
questions.explanation: 问句用系动词 were frightened,应答省略 frightened 后保留与「I」一致的 was。

questions.stem: "You may go to the shelter now if you'd like ____."
questions.explanation: would like 后省略 go to the shelter,只保留不定式符号 to。

questions.stem: "She used to fear every storm, but these days she doesn't seem ____ any more."
questions.explanation: seem 后省略 fear every storm,只留不定式符号 to。
